query_choice: User-permitted technically conservative cleanup-only variant, selected now before query results; grouped OR/parenthesis semantics are not assumed. No OR probe or alternate terms will be issued.
order: Freeze the first successful oldest-first response identity frame; retain server order and sort those first five by created_at then numeric issue ID. No pagination or sixth issue. If requested sort/identity coverage cannot be established, ORDER_UNVERIFIED_HOLD.
case_rule: Inspect only the fixed five in order. First qualifying actual lifecycle defect with an authoritative accepted upstream fix link, exact correction commit, its verified first-parent before revision, meaningful trigger/natural benign control, and bounded no-external-service local reproduction. Closed alone is not fix authority.
fix_rule: Use the first authoritative closing/fix link in event timestamp then stable ID order. before_sha must be the correction commit's first parent, never a guessed branch/base. Unclear linkage or mixed-property pair means PROVENANCE_HOLD, not alternate commit shopping.
selection_vs_execution: Choose at most one source-qualifying defect/project before native results. Core expressibility is not an eligibility filter. Once chosen, environment/reproduction/core-change failure stays on that case; do not try another.
negatives: Retain each reviewed ref, order, exclusion/hold reason and source hashes. If none of first five qualifies, NO_ELIGIBLE_CASE_FROM_FROZEN_FIVE; no substitute query/project. Neither project has a selected case yet.
raw_records: Persist exact request arguments, attempt/time/status, available unmodified connector payload, source hashes and raw-HTTP availability limitations. Archive identity frame before body review.
receipt_gate: No issue/title/body/fix/source-behavior lookup until parent records receipt of this exact frame02/SELECTION_SEAL.json hash. The negative old-frame receipt does not release this gate.
native_review: Parent provides nonauthor AI review before native runs. Review the case-specific source/native reference/fixtures/runtime/contract/equal-information baseline seal. This source plan alone is not execution approval.
